item.description: Skye Newman returns with Walk, a sharp single about reclaiming power, as her chart success and major tour slots cement her rising global profile.

item.title: Lamborghini Lanzador EV cancelled – ICE to continue “for as long as possible”
item.description: Lamborghini Lanzador will not proceed as a full battery-electric production model, according to a report by The Sunday Times. Lamborghini CEO Stephan Winkelmann reportedly told the British newspaper that demand for full EVs within the brand’s target market is currently “close to zero”, prompting the decision to halt development of the all-electric model. item.title: Malaysia sees 90% compliance with online content takedown requests
item.description: Deputy Communications Minister Teo Nie Ching reveals high compliance rates for online content removal under new and existing laws in the first two months of 2025.

item.title: Study on DBKL law amendments will not touch Agong’s powers
item.description: The government assures that a study on amending the Federal Capital Act will not affect the powers of the Agong or the Rulers, respecting Kuala Lumpur's history.
